description: Golden test vectors for the sealed_trace envelope format (v1).
TEST ONLY: the private key below is published on purpose and protects nothing.
RSA-OAEP is randomized, so wrappedKey differs on every encryption. Verify envelopes by DECRYPTING them, not by comparing wrappedKey bytes.
aesGcmCases are fully deterministic: the same key, iv and plaintext must give exactly the listed ciphertext and tag.
envelopes hold complete wire envelopes (the shape POSTed to /api/v1/ingest/logs), the AES key they must unwrap to, and the plaintext they must decrypt to.

specification.plaintext: UTF-8 bytes of the compact JSON array of LogEvent objects (no spaces, keys in the order id, seq, ts, level, tag, message, error, stackTrace, metadata, sessionId, userId, ctx; non-ASCII characters are not escaped).
specification.aes: AES-256-GCM, 32-byte random key, 12-byte random IV, no additional authenticated data, 16-byte tag stored separately from the ciphertext.
specification.rsa: RSA-OAEP over the 32-byte AES key: 2048-bit key, SHA-256 label hash, MGF1 with SHA-256, empty label. wrappedKey is 256 bytes.

openssl: Save the private key as test_private.pem and one wrappedKey as wrapped.b64, then:
openssl pkeyutl -decrypt -inkey test_private.pem -in wrapped.bin -pkeyopt rsa_padding_mode:oaep -pkeyopt rsa_oaep_md:sha256 -pkeyopt rsa_mgf1_md:sha256 | base64
The output must equal the case's aesKeyBase64.
